description: Experiment E (retrieval modes), EXPLORATORY: 11 questions in the evaluation universe (fewer than 15). One rag-retrieval-eval ops task (org.scholarchain.rag.eval.RetrievalEvalJob, no LLM call) runs the benchmark-v1 evaluation set (11 questions with labelled target researcher IDs, 100 labels; 19 questions not-comparable, listed in the report, never scored) in three modes: graph-only (the planner's deterministic resolver and graph templates on Neptune and DynamoDB, without synthesis), vector-only (the question embedded with the configured Voyage query model, top-K from the researcher-profile-v1 S3 Vectors index) and fused (reciprocal-rank fusion, k = 60, fusion-exp-v1; experiment only; the production workflow has no fused ranking). Metrics per mode over the same 11 questions and the same K values (1, 5, 10, 30): recall@K, MRR, errors, empty results, abstentions, by-design-weak questions, latency per question (median, p95); nDCG is not computed (benchmark-v1 has no graded labels). The collector runs scripts/run-bounded-pipeline.sh --stage load --loader rag-retrieval-eval with these arguments unchanged, copies the report from s3://{data-bucket}/rag/retrieval-eval/ATTEMPT/report.json into the run folder and extracts retrieval-modes.csv. Reads the Phase 14 graph run:v1:f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4 (Neptune, DynamoDB) and the Phase 14 vectors; writes only the report object. Runs at the session 2 build commit and the D3 plan, after D7 and before D11a (its nested pipeline needs a clean tree). No scaling evidence is expected from E.
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml); the Phase 14 graph run:v1:f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4 in Neptune and DynamoDB, the researcher-profile-v1 vectors of the Phase 14 export run=f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4, and the question set benchmark-v1 (packaged evaluation set derived by RetrievalEvalSet)

resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/modules/runtime/variables.tf task_sizes.ops (1 vCPU, 4 GB) and the ops task definition (main.tf); scripts/run-bounded-pipeline.sh (one ops task at a time; --wait-timeout 60..14400 and at least the job limit + 300 s); RetrievalEvalJob bounds (--max-seconds 60..3600, --question-timeout-seconds 5..300)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. LABEL: EXPLORATORY in every table (11 questions in the universe, fewer than 15); the fused mode is labelled experiment only (the production workflow has no fused ranking); the universe is never widened and no label is added. WAIT LIMITS: the job's total limit --max-seconds 1200 is checked only when a question starts, so a run can end up to about 12 minutes later (review finding H-02: per question up to 60 s graph + 60 s vector + 10 x 60 s drift checks; graph reads stop at runtime.graphTimeoutMillis 20 s in practice); --wait-timeout 2400 = 1200 + 720 overrun + about 480 for the Fargate task start, the report copy and margin, above the pipeline's rule (limit + 300 = 1500) and the collector's own rule (limit + 300 + 720 = 2220); the collector's outer limit is 2400 + 600 = 3000 s for the pipeline's own steps; maxDurationSeconds 3600 = start and Terraform outputs about 120 + outer limit 3000 + report copy and extraction about 120 + 360 margin. Expected duration about 6 to 8 minutes (rag estimate 3 to 5 minutes including the task start, plus the pipeline's checks; estimate). COST (estimate, from COSTS.md rates and rag's call counts): the ops task (1 vCPU, 4 GB, about $0.05 per hour) for about 8 minutes, about $0.01; at its full limits (3000 s) about $0.05; about 130 Neptune reads (I/O $0.20 per million, negligible), about 11 DynamoDB Query and 40 GetItem, 11 S3 Vectors QueryVectors, 1 S3 PutObject, 11 Voyage query embeddings (about 330 tokens, inside the free allowance), no Anthropic call; the runner's metric export (8 series) negligible; expected about $0.01, upper bound under $0.10; costBoundUsd 0.2. METRICS: AWS/Neptune CPUUtilization, OpenCypherRequestsPerSec, TotalRequestsPerSec, TotalServerErrorsPerSec, MainRequestQueuePendingRequests with DBClusterIdentifier: seen in account (6b list-metrics; dimension DBClusterIdentifier re-checked in 6c); AWS/DynamoDB ConsumedReadCapacityUnits for researcher-metric-cache, entity-link-cache and evidence-bundle: seen in account (6c list-metrics). AWS/ECS for the ops task window: DROPPED, the account lists AWS/ECS series only with ClusterName and ServiceName (6c list-metrics), the ops task is a run-task without a service and Container Insights is off, so no CPU or memory series exists for it; its lifecycle (start, stop, container exit) is in the nested run record. Latency per question and per mode comes from the report (primary); CloudWatch supports it only in 60 s periods. LIMITATIONS known in advance: exploratory (11 questions); q25 and q26 targets are the top 10 of the benchmark's labelled pool by rag's derivation rule, not benchmark labels as such (review finding H-03), and graph-only abstains on them by design (topic-candidates-failed, counted as abstentions, by-design-weak); graph-only is partly circular with labels computed from a graph; the labels come from source run run:v1:51b50d578d5b609842c1c21b8266a00b, not the Phase 14 graph, so label drift is reported per question (labelsNotInGraph, kept in the denominator); vector-only queries only researcher-profile-v1; a mode that errors or returns nothing scores 0 for that question and is counted under errors or empty; the recall and MRR plots put K, not UTC, on the x axis (review finding J-04, to be recorded as a deviation); E gives no scaling evidence (decision 3); first live use of the ops role's neptune-db:ReadDataViaQuery (infra 5b).
